created_before: Any new wave 17b STOP candidate evaluation or clean union fit; numerical method fixed after the separate TRAIN-only diagnostic
parent: Complete wave 16 policy, plus hash-verified wave 17 clean anchors and successful binary grids. Failed wave 17 is preserved; no partially selected policy promoted.
anchors: Reuse all 24 wave 17 clean TRAIN anchors with original saved model hashes, exact row order/schema and clean controls. No new TRAIN tree fits. Preserve all four expanded sources and original stopping exclusions.
selection: Reuse exact 12 binary grids and choices, including 96 nonidentity evaluations. Recompute all 12 regression grids from the same clean anchors with fixed original unscaled LSQR from zero, atol=btol1e-12, conlim1e8, maximum 10000 iterations, and strict original-coordinate certificates. Lambda [1,10,100,1000] and shrinkage [0.25,1] remain unchanged. Forty-eight isolated penalty workers each perform one solve plus two native shrinkage checks; 96 new nonidentity evaluations. Recheck each reused regression identity prediction per penalty; there are 24 unique identity candidates across the whole study. Exact STOP ties favor identity, then larger lambda, then smaller shrinkage. Every reused and new candidate must pass before all 24 choices freeze.
transfer: Mandatory 24 fresh CLEAN union/expanded native fits, including identity choices. Disable BOTH old correction fields before every fit. Same fixed tree parameters, requested counts, seed 47 and exact original union/expanded row order. Compare nonleaf native state, schema and CT training pipeline against the corrected parent (only old scalar leaf values may differ) before the new fold; failure closes the gate, no fallback. Apply ONLY the newly selected correction via one fixed solve on fresh fitting rows. Never use the old corrected parent as baseline. Keep 12 multiclass models exactly. No DEV model choice.
native_validation: Exact reconstructed ordered fitting transform and state for CTBoost. Full nonleaf features, thresholds, category routes, class bias and schema preserved; exact routing, analytical roundoff bound and strict rtol 5e-5 / atol 1e-5 raw prediction oracle plus independent sparse-matrix oracle and exact pickle checks. No correction stacking. Historical native training statistics remain unchanged by leaf correction; corrected models are inference artifacts.

resources.scope: Each separate regression penalty solve plus its two native shrinkage checks, each clean union fit plus selected correction, and each fresh seed model has 1200 seconds and 8 GiB process-tree RSS. Four GiB named arrays include an extra 256*(rows+columns) regression solver/certificate reserve. Separate penalty jobs repeat design construction; this cost is reported. No within-attempt relaxation or failed-candidate fallback.

conditional_seed_trigger: The full 12-dataset primary seed 47 development gate passes both comparators
conditional_seed_policy: All 36 fresh seed 569 models, same requested counts, parameters and four expanded sources. For 8 binary/regression tasks remove both old scalar corrections before fitting, then apply only fixed new controls with no STOP selection. For 4 multiclass tasks delegate the unchanged wave 16 fixed multiclass correction and temperature policy. Recompute coefficients only on fitting rows. Same watchdogs; average 47/569 errors within 12 datasets before aggregation and report both seeds. Cross-seed native topology is not expected equal; the required clean-parent topology check applies to deterministic seed 47 final refits.
official_test: Only after primary and mean-seed gates, freeze 72 already-trained native models and executable/runtime/source/split hashes, then perform one official test assessment. No fit or adjustment after test; original confirmation remains unopened.
limitations: Adaptive reused development. Fresh TRAIN anchors retain tree controls and counts chosen using prior STOP/CV. Equal penalty and shrinkage counts do not equal compute, capacity or effective regularization. The binary solver optimizes logistic loss while STOP selection uses AUC. Refitting and expanded rows alter the baseline and penalty optimum; no union STOP reselection. Mandatory clean identity can differ from the old corrected parent, with no DEV fallback. Same-split seed sensitivity is not independent replication, significance or an official ranking. Numerical repair is not an accuracy improvement claim. Reused binary evaluations and anchors are reported separately from new work. The solver was chosen using TRAIN-only certification before any new STOP results; no CTR precision runtime change.
